title: Autonomous mechanism discovery for Zn-catalyzed diyne formation
difficulty_reasons: The mechanism and oxidation-state pathway are undisclosed and must be generated, compared and discriminated.
The task requires broad but bounded candidate coverage, validated stationary points, connectivity evidence and a defensible stopping report.

paper.title: Towards understanding the molecular mechanism of Cadiot-Chodkiewicz cross-coupling reaction

data.description: Explicit molecular identities, roles, charges, multiplicities, solvent and reaction endpoint.

required_deliverables.description: Independent candidate search, validated mechanism, energetics and conclusion.
